**Article Details for PMID: 29247073**

**Title:** Comparative effect of statins on the risk of incident Alzheimer disease.

**Authors:** Liliya Sinyavskaya, Serge Gauthier, Christel Renoux, Sophie Dell'Aniello, Samy Suissa, Paul Brassard

**Journal:** Neurology
**Publication Date:** 2019-07-22
**DOI:** 10.1212/WNL.0000000000004818

**Abstract:**
To investigate whether fungus-derived statins are associated with a lower risk of incident Alzheimer disease (AD) compared with synthetic statins using real-world clinical practice data.

**Note:** Full text is not available in PubMed Central. You may need institutional access or subscription to view the complete article.
